ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the above food web, what is the source of energy for the caterpillar?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the food web there is “Plant”, and arrows branch out from Plant pointing respectively to aphid, caterpillar, and whitefly. The “caterpillar” in the middle receives an arrow from Plant, and there is an arrow from caterpillar pointing to bird. Reasoning: The arrows in the food web indicate that energy flows from the source that is eaten to the organism that obtains energy. Because the arrow points from Plant to caterpillar, the energy source of caterpillar is Plant.
